review_queue.audit_reasoning: EXPOSES centers on authenticate/authorize/authorize_artifact, which accept credentials, operations, scopes and return permit/deny verdicts (None-or-raise), plus validate_disclosure and runtime credential resolution. Wrong grant logic (e.g. extraction gaining application mutation via plan text or redirects) silently escalates privilege rather than failing loudly. Invariants EXT-AUTHORITY and EXT-READ-ONLY are behavioral policy, not structural shapes, so this is A.

EXPOSES stage_admission, acquire_slot, release_slot and fence_workflow implement quota-governed admission (shard cap 12, account cap 3) with backpressure and queue-budget consumption. Wrong bucket/quota logic silently over-admits or starves work. Schedulers are explicitly A, and the allocation verdicts have silent wrong-output modes.

EXPOSES publish_dispatch, publish_observation and publish_execution enforce the dispatch and observation state machines (allowed-transition tables, revision sequencing), not mere record construction. Transition errors such as authorizing a second logical execution via same-state revision, or comparing boundary-scoped assertions by receipt order, pass trivial checks and corrupt lifecycle state silently. That is A decision logic, not I routing.

EXPOSES handle_challenge, which selects and executes challenge recovery under commissioned recovery and cost budgets. Interpreting a provider token, clearance or page continuation as application success is a silent verdict error, and recovery-path decisions carry edge cases. That is A recovery-decision logic.

EXPOSES validate_measurement, which checks Measurement clock/boot/origin structure, and remaining_limit, which is deadline arithmetic. EK-TIME/EK-TIMING-INTERPRETATION forbid cross-clock subtraction and UTC-as-elapsed misuse. Errors surface as validation failures on time structures, indicating S.

EXPOSES start and dispatch, where start must commit durable admission, queue mutation, handle binding, idempotency association, intent and replayable response as one owner-local durable effect before acknowledgement (EK-ATOMICITY). Split acks or racing Starts silently double-execute: naive code passes single-threaded tests and fails under interleaving, which is the B signature and catastrophic if wrong.

EXPOSES extract_html and extract_live map HTML or live DOM to TaskOutput under a pinned output schema. Fabricating missing required fields, or claiming a partial object satisfies a strict complete-output schema, compiles and passes trivial assertions while yielding silently wrong output. Those completeness verdicts indicate A.

Beyond append, resolve and read_prefix, EXPOSES commit_owner_effect with expected_revision and command_key: an optimistic-concurrency atomic commit coupling authoritative effects, idempotency record and journal events (EK-ATOMICITY). Acknowledging before durable append or separating effects from their commit passes single-threaded tests and breaks under interleaving, indicating B.

EXPOSES load_learning_entry and publish_learning_entry: a versioned cache store keyed under StatePolicy. Frozen-policy write refusal and no-silent-migration rules are structural version discipline over stored entries (EK-ARTIFACTS), indicating S rather than computed verdicts.

EXPOSES control and expire_observation fanning out RequestNativeCancel, CloseObservationConnection, ReleaseNativeContext and Contain as separately evidenced operations with drain bounds. Coupling them into one inferred effect, or silently containing after release failure, passes single-threaded tests and is catastrophic under interleaving, indicating B.

EXPOSES a single async request_model that takes a role, prompt artifact and scope and returns a stored response artifact: a model-provider gateway. Pinned provider order, failover, required headers and circuit-breaker policy are routing/transport behavior with loud errors, indicating I rather than the S data-shape the name suffix suggests.

EXPOSES claim_step returning execute, completed or uncertain verdicts, plus record_step, save_checkpoint and validate_resume. Misclassifying an ambiguous delivery (missing response, expired lease) as safe resend silently double-executes a side effect; the tri-state claim table is decision logic with silent wrong modes, indicating A rather than a structural ledger.

EXPOSES normalize_report mapping raw terminal/callback/stream bytes to correlated NativeReportObservations. Attaching an uncorrelated callback to a handle, discarding trace mismatch, replacing conflicting reports with latest, or promoting HTTP success to commitment all produce silently wrong facts. EK-CLAIMS correlation semantics are behavioral verdicts, indicating A, not I conversion.

EXPOSES deliver, invoke_native_control and close_native_connection: carrier delivery of prepared tasks with materialized credentials. Given a preparation and handle, deliver over the wire; errors such as inferring acceptance from queueing are mapping errors on delivery, indicating I transport behavior.

EXPOSES replay_diagnostic re-deriving a diagnostic as a deterministic function of manifest, prefix and pinned classifier bundle and returning a match receipt. Reporting matched when required inputs or comparisons are unavailable is silent false verification, and EK-ASSESSMENT comparison semantics are behavioral, indicating A.

EXPOSES publish_axis and report_is_current: monotonic immutable revision records where each axis has exactly one bound writer. Revision sequencing (previous + 1, integrity conflict on same key) and input-pin freshness are structural version validation, indicating S; the interface enforces no leases, fencing or epochs.

EXPOSES reduce_document and await_readiness, each taking a binding, request and scope and returning a result or typed CFFailure, both consuming camoufox_binding.invoke_primitive. The shape is dispatch-to-browser with loud failure codes (Given A, route to B), indicating I rather than structural observation records.

EXPOSES open_profile, recycle_profile and shutdown_profiles governing browser profile lifecycle. Fingerprint-surface equality (not manifest-hash equality), flush/exit evidence sufficiency and recycle timing are policy verdicts; claiming clean exit after forced death is silent wrong output, indicating A supervision logic.

EXPOSES token register/resolve/invalidate plus fence_profile and record_profile_exit scoped by binding digests. Reusing tokens across routes, controller lifetimes, process generations or document epochs, or treating fencing as proof work stopped, passes single-threaded tests and fails across lifetimes. EK-LEASE/RESTART epoch coordination is B-core, not a structural registry.

EXPOSES resolve_target and translate_selector: selector-to-element matching with uniqueness decisions. Clicking the first of multiple matches or inferring uniqueness from partial results silently mistargets execution. Matchers with silently-wrong edge cases are explicitly A.

EXPOSES prepare and validate_start_preparation validating task, mapping, grants and limits across five budget dimensions and six concern categories. Assigning a blocking mapping or enforcement failure a nonblocking-concern disposition silently dispatches unprepared work. Those classification verdicts indicate A.

EXPOSES propose_selector generating selector-repair proposals from failed transcripts and documents via the model conduit. Repair/recovery policy bounds and raw-versus-repaired response handling govern healing verdicts whose errors surface as wrong recovery, indicating the A recovery pipeline.

EXPOSES localize_target producing coordinate-localization artifacts under viewport, scale, crop-origin and frame evidence. Accepting dHash similarity alone as correspondence, or defaulting missing geometry, silently mislocalizes targets. Scoring/threshold logic with silent wrong modes indicates A.

EXPOSES is a credit-reservation protocol: reserve response/control/page capacity before wire, settle afterwards. That is admission plumbing around transport ("given request, reserve route capacity"), and C35 tests a back-pressure routing property (full data queues must not block reserved control progress). Considered B because reservations gate concurrency, but there are no fencing tokens or epochs here, only capacity accounting, so I fits better.

EXPOSES functions take principal, request, and registration records and return a Grant or Fault, i.e. permit/deny verdicts over ownership and provenance rules. C06 tests spoof edge cases (caller-supplied provenance, upgraded importer evidence). A wrong rule silently mints authority for forged principals, which is a classifier-like silent failure, not a data shape.

EXPOSES reads a pinned capability descriptor catalog (one subject/version/mode/surface scope) and reports configuration and capability presence. That is registry/catalog behavior per the S definition, and C46 checks honest reporting of table entries (placeholder solver, missing counts stay unverified) rather than exercising decision thresholds.

EXPOSES is a dispatcher: control() routes a request to the mapped native operation via the NativeControls trait. C39 tests that the seven lifecycle operations remain distinct routings rather than collapsing into each other. Serialization and fencing live in sessions/leases; this module maps and invokes, so I fits and the heuristic's name-based B signal misleads.

Despite the data-like name, EXPOSES functions decide traversal: plan the next cursor step, plan what a packet may commit, and judge resume validity. C28/C29 test semantic edge cases (numeric positional aliases allowed only under deterministic per-run ordering; uncertified walks must never be presented as certified). Wrong rules silently certify unproven pagination.

EXPOSES derives canonical fetch keys (SHA256 over framed identity) and decides noop-versus-write on key equality. That is deterministic derivation plus comparison plumbing feeding the archives atomic protocol. C19 tests exactly the same-key property, so core mistakes surface as detectable mismatches rather than silent misjudgment.

EXPOSES functions are codecs and framing utilities: digest bytes, canonicalize records, reconcile source hashes, frame references, verify digests. C05 tests loud rejection edges (wrong bytes/framing rejected, hash-of-a-hash-string refused). The algorithmic-looking section references name the profiles to implement, not decision logic the module owns.

EXPOSES is a backend adapter to the separately-bounded SLM process: ensure readiness, run a batch, report containment events. The classification math lives in crawler_classifier; the host routes batches across the isolation boundary. C17 tests fault isolation (SLM memory failure must not terminate the crawler), an adapter property.

EXPOSES translates source rows of eleven entity types into normalized snapshots and assembles crawler values. That is translator work ("given source row, convert to snapshot"), and C01 checks field survival across conversion. No thresholds, verdicts, or proofs are computed here despite the algorithmic-looking section references.

EXPOSES is orchestration: advance commands through stages, route listings to surfaces, validate transaction scope. C08 checks the static surface/stage participation table and C12 checks no orphan rows beyond durable packets. The silent-judgment work (proof evaluation, detector triggers, classification) is delegated to coverage/detectors/classifier, so this module dispatches rather than decides.

EXPOSES recover interprets an incident against the declared fault model and scopes what survives and what must be re-established across leases, sessions, archives, and pipeline. C44 tests those scoping judgments (acknowledged entities survive process/reboot; proven partitions are not refetched). Wrong scoping silently drops work or churns proven state.

EXPOSES derive_diagnostic (deterministic recomputation over manifest, journal prefix, classifier bundle) and replay_offline, which recomputes derived outputs and returns a matched/unmatched comparison verdict. C43 tests the comparison logic: no external execution, missing inputs stay unavailable, all required comparisons must match. A lax comparison silently certifies divergent replays while passing shape checks.

EXPOSES implements retention pinning and fenced collection: pins protect transitive dependencies and GC must be fenced against concurrent pin creation. C25 tests the retention race directly. A reachability check that is correct single-threaded still deletes live archives if it races pin creation, which is the B failure signature.

EXPOSES is the composition root: serve_connector routes the nine connector verbs to their modules and drive_committed_work executes already-committed work. No thresholds, proofs, or classifications are computed here; C45 tests that the wiring ships and runs independently. Top-level dispatch and driver orchestration.

EXPOSES computes exact successful membership and plans membership transitions from store state. C18 tests semantic eligibility edges: only eligible successful details join, snippet-only vetoes never count, and hits must not suppress coverage observations. Wrong eligibility silently corrupts coverage reuse while passing shape checks.

EXPOSES manages session generations with owner epochs, single-in-flight serialization for rotating jars, and cold crash recovery. C32/C33 test stateful serialization, epoch enforcement, independent shards, and recovery. Concurrent stateful requests or replayed snapshots pass single-threaded tests and corrupt cookie jars or resurrect stale owners under interleaving.

EXPOSES transact commits admitted input, idempotency record, effects, journal evidence, and replayable response as one owner-local durable effect, with fencing-predicate and transition checks. C07/C22 test journal contiguity/conflicts and ingest-vs-product writer isolation. Accepting stale fencing predicates passes solo tests and forks journal truth under concurrency.

EXPOSES AdmitSession/AdvanceAdmission orchestrate a 10-step cross-owner saga (manifest install, commission registration, async owner init) returning EvidenceRef receipts, not verdicts. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin sequencing and durability (durable admission survives later init failure, saga never uses cross-owner atomic commit) — coordination failures refuse loudly rather than corrupt silently. Saga orchestration across owners is integration glue.

EXPOSES AnalyzeSession takes manifest plus request and returns a DiagnosticDocument, but every finding is delegated to diagnostic_reducer.DeriveDiagnostic; the module itself loads prefixes, commits artifacts, renders, and seals rows. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin prefix identity and byte-immutability across reanalysis — durability properties, not finding-correctness. Verdict production lives downstream; this module is owner orchestration.

EXPOSES NewApplicationHandler/InitializeApplication/SealApplication is an HTTP endpoint binding plus owner-local commit sequencing over fixture_reducer and lifecycle_rules. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin durability and binding (upload needs durable verified bytes, opaque attempt binding, no peer-publication wait) — request-handling properties with loud failures. The business judgments (validation, transitions) live in the reducer and rules modules.

EXPOSES Authenticate/Authorize return permit/deny decisions (context or error) derived from request plus policy — verdicts, not routed bytes. TEST_ASSERTIONS are all adversarial edge cases (application cookies, caller-supplied principals, digests-as-bearers) where wrong logic fails silent-open, not loud. INVARIANTS describe identity derivation and scope grants — a policy decision procedure with catastrophic silent failure.

EXPOSES ValidateMeasurement/ComputeDeadline return validity verdicts and derived TimePoints from measurements plus clock descriptors. TEST_ASSERTIONS probe semantic edges (cross-clock and cross-boot rejection, UTC-adjustment invariance, no invented primitive durations) — a wrong accept yields silently wrong durations, not a parse error. INVARIANTS are timing-interpretation behavior, not field presence.

EXPOSES ObserveHandle/CollectHandleArtifacts map ConnectorRequest to ConnectorResponse via store reads — request/response endpoint handling. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin cursor, cutoff, and chunk behaviors with explicit errors (oversized returns error without silent dropping, lost cursor history is explicit). Artifact transfer validates digests, progress bounds, and EOF — loud protocol behavior.

EXPOSES RenderDiagnostic converts one DiagnosticDocument into two byte forms (readable plus JSON) — a serializer with a same-object fidelity constraint and no scoring or decision branches. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin rendering fidelity (same diagnostic in both forms, disabled analyses render reasoned missingness, scope preserved). It reads algorithmic seam sections but implements deterministic translation: a scope-not-class case.

EXPOSES Export/LoadReplayInputs/ExportValidationBundle package and unpackage replay and validation bundles with transitive dependencies and access labels. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin completeness and digest identity (every transitive replay dependency included, friendly names resolve to exact bytes, redaction takes a new identity). Digest-verified load makes omissions loud rather than silent.

EXPOSES ImportSourcePrefix verifies a source prefix against policy and commits importer-provenance copies, returning EvidenceRefs — with dedup (identical imports produce no new effects), conflict detection (conflicting bytes raise integrity incidents), and scope preservation (historical stays historical unscored). Wrong scope or dedup logic silently contaminates downstream diagnostics, and the assertions pin exactly these silent-corruption edges.

EXPOSES ValidateFixture admits or rejects experiment configurations on semantic policy: hostile-treatment rejection, human-path requirements, budget and recovery contracts, graceful degradation, no executable code. 'Fixture' here is the laboratory experiment, not test harness — admission consumes this validator on the production path. A wrong accept silently admits hostile or impossible configs; assertions probe policy edges.

EXPOSES is empty; the module assembles control, application, and telemetry handlers with the session runtime over exactly three independent databases. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin assembly properties (three databases, synthetic-peer suites, no live dependencies, SPA embedded without runtime merging). Pure composition root with no decision logic.

EXPOSES ValidateJournal/ResolveEvidence verify hash chains, contiguous admission-first sequences, prefix-head equality with the last verified event hash, and all-coordinate evidence agreement — proof-checking that returns validity verdicts. A skipped hash or coordinate check silently admits forged or rewound history. TEST_ASSERTIONS probe chain and ordering edges (future-registration citation, beyond-prefix rejection), not field shapes.

EXPOSES CheckManualAcceptance verifies the fourteen-step walkthrough evidence against replay inputs and emits acceptance bytes — a step-transition checker with submit-once uniqueness, monotonic-reference timing, and digest gates. A skipped gate silently passes an incomplete walkthrough. It runs as a production control-plane gate, not test infrastructure.

EXPOSES NewTelemetryHandler/InitializeObservation/RecordManualNote/CloseObservationWindow implement HTTP telemetry ingress plus owner-local commit sequencing with producer deduplication and closure revisions. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin ingress and commit behavior (client-authored server fields rejected, identical delivery deduplicated, closure without completeness proof) — endpoint plus durability properties. Completeness judgments belong to the lifecycle reconciler.

EXPOSES CommitOwner/InstallArtifact/LoadPrefix/RetainRoot implement owner-local atomic commits, content-addressed durability, garbage collection fenced against concurrent pin creation, WAL with full synchronization, and lease-epoch gating (stale lease epoch cannot commit or double-charge retry). TEST_ASSERTIONS are crash and interleaving properties (busy-writer isolation, crash-orphan versus replayable-response, fenced GC). Naive single-threaded-correct code fails here under interleaving — the B profile, catastrophic if wrong.

EXPOSES InstallPublication/SealRow/ExpandArchive implement verified asynchronous transfer with atomic view-pointer advance, seal version-vectors, and archive expansion. Integrity failures are loud by design (corrupt bytes cannot advance the pointer, reordered delivery cannot roll it back, same-revision-different-bytes conflicts). There are no leases, fencing tokens, or epoch coordination — the heuristic B rested on zero B-signals.

EXPOSES NewReferenceConnector builds the full external-connector HTTP surface (prepare, start, idempotency, resume, close, controls) over a native RoundTripper. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin protocol conformance (durable handles before wire delivery, repeated start returns the same handle, unsupported context release returns typed control evidence) — endpoint-binding behavior with loud typed errors.

EXPOSES ServeSessionWork/FinalizeSession drive the runtime saga: admission advance, observation and application coordination, closure, and finalization across restarts. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin recovery and orchestration behavior (dispatch-uncertain recovery, epoch-fenced restart without assuming native stop, closure despite unavailable seal, every session finalizes or records interruption) — each recovery mapping is directly pinned, so wrong mappings fail loudly. It sequences fencing implemented elsewhere.

EXPOSES VerifySource returns SourceChecks trust verdicts (authentication plus attempt correlation) for raw artifacts under a pinned policy. Wrong logic fails silent-accept — trusting serialized verified flags or correlating by trace alone admits forged claims. TEST_ASSERTIONS pin exactly these forgery edges (uncorrelated callbacks produce no claim, missing signing contracts leave authentication unknown). A detector over verification evidence, not a byte-moving adapter.

EXPOSES a single authorize call mapping channel/operation/resource IDs to a ProducerDescriptor per the actor write-grants table, which is rule-table consultation rather than scored judgment. TEST_ASSERTIONS check spoofed-identity rejection and secret quarantine, both directly pinned identity/field checks. INVARIANTS govern provenance assignment and authority derivation, i.e. record-issuing rules. Failures are caught by the suite, not silent.

EXPOSES verify_replacement plus revise_retention, and the retention lifecycle requires concurrency-safe reachability fencing before any dependency is released. TEST_ASSERTIONS probe a reclaimed-while-reachable race and pointer-race reselection, which pass single-threaded and fail under interleaving. A wrong release silently destroys archives, the catastrophic B profile. The structural validation half is real but subordinate to the fencing risk.

EXPOSES a single async control_task mapping a ConnectorRequest to a ControlReceipt or error, dispatching the four control verbs over the connector transport. That is endpoint dispatch, given a request route to a receipt. The subtle semantic separations, cancel-ack versus no-commit-fact and containment versus certified cancellation, are each directly asserted, so errors are caught rather than silent. No epoch, fencing-token, or atomicity logic is present.

EXPOSES a single async observe_task returning an ObservationPage for a connector request, projecting already-journaled observations across the connector boundary. Assertions pin loud contract points: cutoff-preserving pagination, empty-page-means-not-termination, explicit oversize errors, uncorrelated-callback handling. The correlation and normalization subtleties are real but each is directly asserted.

EXPOSES mail synchronization and followup sending, moving messages across the provider boundary through provider effects with model-assisted drafting. That is an external-service adapter. Assertions pin loud guards: title-only similarity creates no fact, history gaps record incomplete observation, duplicate notifications dedup. No scoring or ranking lives here.

EXPOSES accept_job_row converting a LogicalRow into an EvaluationJobInput at the read-only crawler boundary, enforcing render, fetch-identity, no-op, and replacement gating. Five assertions pin loud rejection modes, so wrong logic surfaces as wrongly accepted or rejected rows. Assessment itself lives downstream in job_evaluation.

EXPOSES manifest admission, event append, prefix read, and effect commit, constructing the system's journal envelopes with hash-chain, contiguous-sequence, and dedup integrity. Journal envelopes are the named S slot. Assertions pin loud integrity behaviors: invalid pointers rejected, same-sequence conflicts recorded as incidents. The atomic-commit discipline is real but structural and single-thread-testable.

EXPOSES generate_materials assembling candidate profile, job snapshot, and optional evaluation through the model gateway into a retained material package. The module orchestrates generation and enforces gates: unsupported claims block automatic submission, submitted versions never rewrite commission materials. Both gates are directly asserted, so failures are loud rather than silent scoring errors.

EXPOSES replay_diagnostic taking a manifest, source diagnostic, input bundle, and replay engine and returning a ReplayReceipt verdict. Recomputing derived outputs and comparing semantic events, final state, and observations involves comparison semantics whose input-gap and equivalence edge cases silently flip matched versus mismatched. That verdict risk exceeds mechanical orchestration.

EXPOSES record_origin_receipt checking a receipt against the pinned origin policy, source/correlation evidence, and attempt scope, then committing an AxisRevision or honest Missing. Acceptance is rule-table-style policy checking, not assessment: verified production receipts accepted, clicks and practice facts rejected. All four guards are directly asserted, so failures are caught.

EXPOSES entity registration and domain commit, writing complete immutable revision snapshots with single-writer ownership and previous-revision-plus-one sequencing. The revision-race, peer-independence, transition-allowance, and history-preservation behaviors are logical revision-number checks, each directly asserted and testable single-threaded. No fencing tokens or epochs are managed here.

EXPOSES build_query combining candidate profile, playbook catalog, veto policy, syntax mapping, family, and board into a QueryArtifact. Choosing which soft exclusions activate, keeping global/crawler/product vetoes distinct, and translating board syntax are policy decisions whose edge-case errors wrongly include or exclude candidates without any parse-level signal. The flagged-not-excluded and syntax-preservation assertions pin only instances.

EXPOSES publication installation, row sealing, and row loading, validating complete bytes and dependencies before constructing PublicationReceipts and LogicalRows with seal vectors. Assertions pin completeness and monotonicity: partial publications rejected, reordering never rolls back, seals pin complete local publications. These are record-construction checks testable single-threaded, with no fence, epoch, or interleaving logic.

EXPOSES nothing and consumes every subsystem module, marking it the production scheduler and composition root rather than a record, adapter, or fence. Its distinctive logic is recovery and gating: observing uncertain work without repeating external effects, and never auto-dispatching production from practice completion. Those branches decide between safe observation and repeated real-world effects, a silent-wrong-output risk profile. No test-infrastructure role fits; it runs production traces.

EXPOSES authorize_work/authorize_owner return ProducerDescriptor grants — allow-and-describe decisions over kind/lineage/role branches (practice/held_in vs production/held_out, rehearsal_of/performance_of). RM-C53 pins only the practice-into-production case, so over-grant edge cases across lineage rules pass assertions silently and surface as wrong-authority writes.

control/close_at_boundary enforce the control-thread versus owner-thread handoff (never calling owner-thread release from the control thread), containment scoping to authorized resources, and fencing without silent escalation. RM-C26 through C29 pin cancel/close/release/containment separations whose confusion under races (e.g., release failure becoming implicit containment) silently mis-authorizes force.

start/claim_work enforce durable-commit-before-delivery, idempotent Start, and lease-gated work claiming. RM-C23 pins crash-around-dispatch honesty and RM-C22 one handle per logical key, but concurrent Starts under one key or a crash between admission and delivery pass single-threaded tests and double-execute silently. That interleaving-only catastrophic mode is the B signature.

commit_owner_effect implements the owner-local atomic commit (admitted input, idempotency record, effects, journal events, replayable response, with bytes installed before registration) and RM-C58 pins crash-boundary behavior. A naive split commit or ack-before-durable passes single-threaded tests and forks or loses the journal under crash. Dedup-versus-integrity-incident (RM-C49) is fencing-adjacent arbitration, not a classifier verdict.

EXPOSES extract_output converts reduction output and primitive returns into TaskOutput under a pinned output schema with a deterministic, model-free profile. RM-C44 pins partial-schema handling (valid partial contract or diagnostic-only artifact), and schema violations fail loudly at validation. The module routes and converts native observations; it renders no verdicts.

EXPOSES select_learning_state and commit_verified_learning decide cache selection and verified promotion, gated on a pinned transition policy plus verification evidence. RM-C43 pins only the frozen-learning case, so wrong confidence, count, or staleness updates — or promoting tentative candidates into verified learning — pass assertions silently and corrupt future recovery decisions.

validate_reconciliation returns consistent, contradicted, or indeterminate verdicts over execution claims versus origin facts with temporal-relation rules (section 16.6). RM-C30 through C32 pin outcome_unknown, entire-attempt no-commit, and receipt-ordering edges, but wrong scope or temporal inference silently yields false reconciled state. The read-side validator decides; it does not merely route.

EXPOSES propose_recovery is a provider conduit (authorized prompt plus budgets in, retained response artifact out) with token reservation, breaker checks, and pinned repair. RM-C36 through C40 pin malformed-output repair, zero-budget refusal, per-call accounting, and missing-denominator handling as loud contract gates. The module adapts to an external provider boundary rather than rendering domain verdicts.

EXPOSES prepare/verify_preparation validate and serialize already-supplied task data into immutable PreparedTask bytes (semantic hash, five-dimension budget mapping, concerns) without visiting targets, testing authentication, or planning. RM-C20 pins the target-network trap and RM-C21 pins stale-input and destination-change rejection — translator failures are loud. The module converts and validates; it does not judge.

drive_once enforces bounded supervision progress (local deadlines, close/control reservation against queue pressure, worker fencing, no fabricated timers on owner loss) on shared service threads. RM-C25 pins that an indefinitely blocked native call never stalls close and control progress — naive awaiting on the deadline or control thread passes idle tests and deadlocks finalization under real interleaving.
